body:
**_Experience the liminality._**

**Liminality** is a datapack meant to recreate the beauty of the popular fictional concept called the "Backrooms". The goal for this datapack is to create endlessly explorable "levels" using world generation and by taking inspiration from the "Backrooms" and hopefully incorporate systems and lore in the future.

This version is an **EARLY** release and will be improved later on as updates come and go!

**LEVELS**
- The Lobby (Level 0)
- Remodeled Mess (Level 0.2)
- The Icy Rooms (Level 0.3)
